name: The Beacon Lounge
description: Beacon Lounge is a lively karaoke bar renowned for its welcoming atmosphere and diverse song selection. Open every night except Sunday, it offers a fun environment with friendly staff and affordable drinks. The venue features a good sound system, ample space for singing, and a mix of locals and visitors. Whether you're there to sing your favorite tunes or enjoy the company, Beacon Lounge provides a relaxed yet energetic karaoke experience that keeps patrons coming back.
